## **General Information**

**Learning outcomes | Knowledge, Skills, and Competences**

The participants will acquire basic knowledge in the application of computational analysis techniques to biological data using R.

The following topics will be addressed in the 'Intro to R data analysis': 

+ **Introduction to R programming**;
+ **Descriptive statistics using R**;
+ **Brief exploratory data analysis of a biological dataset**.

<br>

### Classes documents

Additional files required for exercises

  - 1. [Mice diet dataset](data/mice_data.txt)
  
  - 2. [Zebrafish morphometrics dataset](data/zebrafish.csv)
